🔥 Rewind | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Capturing and editing gameplay moments locally without performance impact or cloud dependency.
✨ Key Features: • Instant Replay • Screen and Game Recording • Quick Screenshots • Local Clip Management • Compress and Share
📖 Summary: Rewind was a lightweight, open-source, local-first gaming recorder designed for instant replay, screen recording, and clip editing. It prioritized performance and privacy by avoiding cloud dependencies, accounts, and telemetry, allowing users to capture and manage their gameplay moments locally. Although development has ceased, the project remains available as a public fork.
